items.exampleEn: The restaurant's menu has an exotic mix of Thai and Mexican flavors.
items.exampleZh: 那家餐廳的菜單融合了泰國和墨西哥的異國風味。

items.exampleEn: After the long hike, we relaxed at a hot spring spa.
items.exampleZh: 長途健行之後，我們去溫泉水療中心放鬆。

items.exampleEn: We chose the coast route because the views are better.
items.exampleZh: 我們選了沿海的路線，因為風景比較好。

items.exampleEn: The passengers clapped after the landing.
items.exampleZh: 飛機降落後，乘客們鼓掌。

items.exampleEn: Finding accommodation in the city during the festival is very hard.
items.exampleZh: 節慶期間要在城裡找到住處非常困難。

items.exampleEn: We had a short stopover in Bangkok on the way to London.
items.exampleZh: 我們去倫敦途中在曼谷短暫停留。

items.exampleEn: Airlines sometimes overbook flights because some people don't show up.
items.exampleZh: 航空公司有時會超賣機位，因為有些人不會出現。

items.exampleEn: Long-distance relationships can be difficult for young couples.
items.exampleZh: 遠距離戀愛對年輕情侶來說可能很辛苦。

items.sentenceEn: The ferry makes a short stopover at a small island.
items.sentenceZh: 渡輪會在一座小島短暫停靠。

items.audioEn: Our flight was overbooked, so the airline asked us to take the next one in the afternoon.
items.audioZh: 我們的班機超賣了，所以航空公司請我們改搭下午的下一班。
items.questionZh: 班機超賣後，航空公司請說話者怎麼做？
options: Pay more for the afternoon flight
Take a later flight that day

items.sentenceEn: The pilot made a smooth landing despite the strong wind.
items.sentenceZh: 儘管風很大，機長還是平穩地降落了。

items.sentenceEn: Long-distance bus tickets are cheaper if you book them early.
items.sentenceZh: 長途客運的車票提早訂會比較便宜。

items.stemEn: The price of the tour includes the ____ at a three-star hotel.
items.stemZh: 這個旅行團的價格包含三星級飯店的住宿。

items.stemEn: The market sells ____ fruits from Southeast Asia that I had never seen before.
items.stemZh: 這個市場賣來自東南亞、我以前從沒見過的異國水果。

items.passageEn: For our tenth wedding anniversary, my husband and I planned a trip to an exotic island in the Indian Ocean. The cheapest route had a long stopover in Singapore, so we spent a night there and walked around the city. The landing on the island was a little scary, because the airport is very small. When we arrived at the island, we found that our hotel was overbooked. The manager apologized and moved us to a beach house with its own small spa, at no extra cost. The accommodation was simple but clean, and the local hospitality made us feel at home. After so many long-distance flights, though, we promised that our next holiday would be closer to home.
items.passageZh: 為了慶祝結婚十週年，我和先生計畫到印度洋上一座充滿異國風情的島嶼旅行。最便宜的路線要在新加坡停留很久，所以我們在那裡住了一晚，到市區走走。在島上降落時有點可怕，因為機場非常小。抵達小島時，我們發現飯店超賣了。經理向我們道歉，並讓我們免費改住一間附有小型水療池的海灘小屋。住處簡單但乾淨，當地人的熱情款待讓我們覺得像在家一樣。不過，搭了這麼多趟長途飛機之後，我們約定下次度假要離家近一點。

questions.questionZh: 他們為什麼在新加坡住了一晚？
options: 最便宜的路線要在那停很久

questions.questionZh: 飯店超賣後，經理怎麼做？

items.promptZh: 這班公車的路線經過火車站和市立醫院。
referenceEn: This bus route goes past the train station and the city hospital.
The route of this bus passes the train station and the city hospital.
rubricZh: 「經過」可寫，例如 goes past、passes 等

items.instructionZh: 用 accommodation 造一個句子，說說你旅行時喜歡住什麼樣的地方。
referenceEn: I prefer cheap accommodation near the train station when I travel.
When I travel, I look for accommodation with a kitchen.
rubricZh: 可用單數或複數（例如 accommodation、accommodations 等）
說習慣，時態合理（例如 prefer、look for 等）
